`class SvgResourceFormat`<br/>
**Implements:** [`IResourceFormat`](/reference/resources/iresourceformat/)<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.resource.format.impl` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [SvgResourceFormat.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/resource/format/impl/SvgResourceFormat.java)

The built-in format of SVG files, rendered as vector images at the size they are drawn.

## Description

The root element must be `<svg>`; an XML declaration, comments and a doctype before it are skipped.
